unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance and human-expert review have not been established.
Representative producer exports, large sparse tables, and unusual taxonomy conventions were not runtime-evaluated.
The bundled self-test uses one deliberately small four-feature by four-sample synthetic table; it checks deterministic descriptive output and fail-closed boundaries, not generalization.
Only explicit TSV feature rows by sample columns and optional canonical rank columns are supported; FASTQ, BIOM, QZA, taxonomy strings, and taxonomy assignment are outside the helper contract.
Windows create-exclusive publication and symlink semantics have not been verified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The count table is not explicitly declared as feature rows by sample columns with the first header feature_id.
decision_sequence.question: Which axis contains feature IDs and which contains sample IDs?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Export features as rows and sample IDs as columns, name the first column feature_id, and do not infer orientation from values.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Negative-control reporting is requested but the exact metadata column or producer-declared values are absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Which exact metadata column and values identify producer-declared negative controls?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use labels fixed by the study or data producer before QC; omit the declaration when no negative controls were defined.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10

runtime_verification.reason: Only the bundled deterministic helper self-test was run. It is a minimum implementation check, not exact-package agent runtime evaluation, representative-data benchmarking, scientific evaluation, generalization evidence, or human-expert review.
